name: Inbox Assistant for Outlook Web
description: Two-level priority senders (Normal/High, with @domain matching) that get flagged stale sooner and can be snoozed, a light/dark theme toggle, follow-up tracking, deduped sender/recipient insights with pie charts, a meeting-cost calculator with a live timer, letterhead-styled PDF/HTML export plus Markdown/Text, and a Schedule Send picker with any-time custom scheduling — all inside Outlook on the web.
